this_title: Armageddon: Os Carros Mais Rápidos do Brasil
trans_title: Armageddon 9th the Fastest cars in Brazil
introduction: The racing competitions known as NO PREP or NO PREPARATION quickly spread throughout Brazil and were divided into lists, each one assigned a number according to the area code of its region. They compete monthly for the top positions on the list to qualify for a major event with the 128 best drivers in Brazil, in a knockout competition until only one remains, the winner
